Frequently Asked Questions

Is my document uploaded to a server?

No. MediaPilot converts your document entirely in your browser using mammoth.js and jsPDF. Your file never leaves your device.

Does this support .doc files?

No, only the modern .docx format. Open the file in Word (or a free alternative) and use "Save As → .docx" first.

Will the PDF look exactly like the original Word document?

Text, headings, bold/italic, lists and tables carry over, but this tool cannot reproduce Word's exact page layout — page breaks, headers/footers, and complex multi-column layouts may not match the original precisely.
